2610.06817.title: Paradee: Distilling Kokoro-82M into an 8M-Parameter Single-Voice Text-to-Speech Model
2610.06817.paper_summary: We distill Kokoro-82M, a widely used open text-to-speech model with 54 voices, into Paradee, an 8.07M-parameter model that speaks one of them. Paradee keeps Kokoro's architecture with much narrower layers, and each of its two halves is trained separately against the frozen teacher. It has 10x fewer parameters and needs 15x less compute. We first synthesize a corpus with the teacher and keep its durations, pitch, energy and phoneme features. We then train a small text side to predict these values, and a small decoder to turn the teacher's saved values into the teacher's audio, first with spectral losses and then adversarially. Finally, we connect the two halves and quantize the weights to int8. It needs no alignment learning and no joint training, and it runs on one laptop. Stored in int8, Paradee is 8.5 MB, runs 25x faster than real time on one CPU thread, and scores 4.41 on UTMOS against the teacher's 4.52. The student initially kept a slight buzz, which we trace to the phase of voiced speech between 2 and 8 kHz. A phase-locking filter applied after synthesis removes most of it, with no training and no extra parameters. Code, model files and audio samples are at https://github.com/sahilmahendrakar/paradee
2610.06817.paper_summary_zh: 我們將Kokoro-82M這個廣泛使用的開放文本轉語音模型（擁有54種聲音）提煉成Paradee，一個擁有8.07M參數的模型，能夠說出其中一種聲音。Paradee保留了Kokoro的架構，但層數更窄，且其兩個部分是分開訓練的，對抗冷凍的教師。它的參數數量少了10倍，計算需求減少了15倍。我們首先與教師合成一個語料庫，並保持其持續時間、音高、能量和音素特徵。然後，我們訓練一個小的文本側來預測這些值，以及一個小的解碼器來將教師保存的值轉換為教師的音頻，首先使用頻譜損失，然後進行對抗訓練。最後，我們將兩個部分連接起來並將權重量化為int8。它不需要對齊學習和聯合訓練，並且可以在一台筆記本電腦上運行。以int8存儲的Paradee大小為8.5 MB，在一個CPU線程上運行速度比實時快25倍，並且在UTMOS上得分4.41，而教師的得分為4.52。學生最初保持著輕微的嗡嗡聲，我們追溯到2到8 kHz之間的有聲語音相位。合成後應用的相位鎖定濾波器去除了大部分噪音，無需訓練和額外參數。代碼、模型文件和音頻樣本可在https://github.com/sahilmahendrakar/paradee找到。
2610.06817.author: Sahil Mahendrakar et.al.
